criteria.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies Northland anti-assignment clause in Section 14.2
criteria.reasoning: The deliverable is a comprehensive extraction table covering 8 contracts, but it does not include any row or data entry for the Northland Refining Master Supply Agreement. The criterion requires identifying the anti-assignment clause in Section 14.2 of the Northland agreement and referencing the 'whether by operation of law or otherwise' language. Although the deliverable mentions "Master Supply Agreement No. MSA-2019-0042 between the Named Insured and Northland Refining Corporation" in a cross-reference field for the Great Lakes Indemnity insurance policy, it provides no extraction row, no Section 14.2 identification, and no anti-assignment provision text from the Northland agreement itself. The criterion explicitly fails if the report does not mention Section 14.2 or the anti-assignment provision in the Northland agreement — both conditions are unmet.

criteria.title: ISSUE_001: Analyzes whether reverse triangular merger constitutes 'assignment by operation of law'

The report analyzes reverse triangular mergers but resolves the question rather than discussing its ambiguity.
